history.summary: A 23-year-old large 1,356 sqft 3BR in Bukit Batok, 460m from Bukit Gombak MRT, asking just $1,106 PSF — a ~10% discount to the $1,228 median — at a low $1.5M absolute. Genuine value (cheap PSF, deep buyer band, near-MRT, 5.9% CAGR), but the age (~77yr lease left), OCR-west location with limited catalysts, and a thinner 71-txn sample temper it to a Buy with the value real but the growth ceiling modest.
history.rating_rationale: Real value play: $1,106 PSF is a ~10% discount to the $1,228 median on a large 1,356 sqft unit, and the $1.5M absolute sits in the deepest buyer band — exactly the affordability profile that resells easily to HDB upgraders. 460m to Bukit Gombak MRT (NSL) gives solid connectivity, 5.9% URA resale CAGR over 71 txns is healthy, ~3.4% yield is among the better in the batch, and score 692 / MMR 1532 is respectable. Held to a plain Buy by the 2003 build (~77yr lease, ageing finishes), the mature D23 west location with no major near-term catalyst (no new MRT line, no govt transformation zone within reach), and a moderate 71-transaction sample. Solid, affordable, fairly-bought — but the upside is steady rather than catalytic.

5.9% URA resale CAGR and ~3.4% gross yield — better income profile than batch peers

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Above-average for the batch. ~3.4% yield, large family-friendly unit near MRT; reliable heartland tenant demand though rents are capped by the OCR-west location.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Steady. 5.9% historical CAGR with a discount-to-median entry gives downside protection, but mature D23 with no catalyst means forward appreciation likely settles near OCR baseline-plus, partly offset by lease decay.
